Problem Statement
Write a program that calculates various salary components of an employee based on the basic salary provided.
Description
Read the basic salary of an employee and perform the following calculations:
House Rent Allowance (HRA) = 20% of Basic Salary
Dearness Allowance (DA) = 10% of Basic Salary
Gross Salary = Basic Salary + HRA + DA
Annual Salary = Gross Salary × 12
Sample Input
30000
Sample Output
HRA: 6000
DA: 3000
Gross Salary: 39000
Annual Salary: 468000
